decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint is close to the firm's metal fabrication know-how in pipe and flange components, so it can absorb and refine the product, though it is only mentioned on the website and so carries somewhat more drop risk.

The ceiling or floor pipe bracket builds directly on the firm's core expertise in fabricated pipe support hardware and has its own website page, so early market results are easy to interpret and improve on.
The pipe support bracket sits squarely within the firm's existing knowledge base and is prominently presented, so it can be developed further using related knowledge the firm already holds.
